title: Akuyaku Reijou no Onii-sama wa Kouryaku Taishougaidesu!!
description: When I thought I was sick and ended my life without going to school, I reincarnated as the villainess Sylvia in the world of the game I played! I was trying to enjoy my second life with a strong body that can move freely. Due to Sylvia’s older brother Rafis, he fails to avoid the ruin flag and is banished to the “Forest of Death”. Rafis begins to say that he will destroy his country for Sylvia in a severe sister complex..?! Akuyaku Reijou no Onii-sama wa Kouryaku Taishougaidesu!!, The Older Brother of the Villainous Daughter Is Not Targeted for Capture!!, 恶役大小姐的兄长不是可攻略对象！,悪役令嬢のお兄様は攻略対象外です!!
